title: Playing with the best and worst, and Paul Barbarin's return
summary: Emile says he worked with every good and bad man; he recalls Paul Barber (Barbarin) starting out with them and being different after he came back.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah, I worked with every good man they had, and every bad man they had. Man, I didn't care who I worked with, long as I was working. Yeah, that's right. That's right. Some man, some man picked their man to work with them. Well, you take a man like Paul Barber and see, Paul Barber and he's a man. Yeah. He wasn't even anybody with him. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I see, Paul had went off, and after he come back he was different, but when he started out, he started out with us. Oh, yeah. That's who he started with.
You say when he came back he was different. In what way he had?

In ways, he wasn't much of a mix anymore. Oh, no? No, he wasn't much of a mix anymore. No. Part is still true, so. Uh-huh. That's why he didn't many, many don't talk about it. No, they don't hardly make anything about Paul. They don't know nothing about it, though. He don't see him.
